scope: Installed OpenJPEG/JBIG2/QuickJS WASM, generated glue, and non-WASM fallbacks only; excludes qcms/Rust and unrelated build tools.

distributionBoundary.rule: Apply each family only when actual staged/emitted bytes match its asset guard, or when embedded generated glue is identified in an emitted bundle. Installed package presence alone must not trigger absent WASM/fallback families. Packaging integration and final emitted-bundle guards are owned by the integration collector.

pdfjsSource.assetCorrespondence: All six standalone installed asset Git blob IDs match the immutable PDF.js release tree; both generated codec glue sources match installed source-map sourcesContent exactly.

embeddedGeneratedGlue.correspondence: sourcesContent equals the pinned upstream generated glue byte-for-byte; final minified bundle hash is intentionally an integration-owner emission concern.
sourcesContent equals the pinned upstream generated glue byte-for-byte; final minified bundle hash is intentionally an integration-owner emission concern.

toolchainProvenance.limitation: Upstream Dockerfiles use emscripten/emsdk:latest, and build.js reuses cached local image names. No immutable image digest, compiler invocation log, or compiler version was recovered. WASM has no custom sections, including no producers. No version is guessed.
reachablePrimaryMethods: Immutable PDF.js release tree and codec asset update commits/PRs 22175, 21980, 21399.
Historical wrapper Dockerfile, compile.sh, and cached-image build.js sources.
Wrapper GitHub Actions and release inventories: no codec build artifacts/toolchain logs were located (OpenJPEG only unrelated Dependabot runs; JBIG2/QuickJS no runs/releases).
Static WASM section parsing; installed generated glue/source maps; corresponding original Emscripten and Binaryen source templates.

generationLowerBound.reason: The preserved moduleRtn name was introduced with this 2024-04-17 generated-module change; the installed glue uses it. QuickJS additionally contains the runtimeInitialized/Module-or-new-Promise branch introduced by d98b029a1d96413f1a88073ccdb47a2b52346d7c on 2025-05-28. These are source-generation bounds, not exact release versions.

emscriptenLicense.unchangedEvidence: LICENSE history has no subsequent change through 893b726a10ccdec91dfa7cbb2a5a79160071a995 (2026-11-06). The same full original bytes occur at the 2018 emmalloc introduction and current source. The root original includes its historical Node-path paragraph; this does not assert Node path runtime is embedded.

emscriptenGlueCopyright.extraction: Complete initial copyright/license comment, verbatim, followed by newline. Full MIT text is provided by pdfjs-codec-emscripten-LICENSE.txt

emmallocCopyright.unchangedEvidence: Copyright/licensing lines match all 31 revisions of system/lib/emmalloc.c from its 2021 C rename through 2026-11-06. All three wrapper compile.sh files explicitly select MALLOC=emmalloc.

muslMit.extraction: Verbatim prefix ending immediately before Authors/contributors include:, including the complete original copyright, MIT terms, and disclaimer. That prefix is byte-identical across both revisions. COPYRIGHT has no intermediate revision; later changes only rename the qsort contributor, separately preserved below. This is not an invented license or a claim that musl version is known.

muslMath.extraction: Distinct complete original copyright/license-bearing C comments, concatenated verbatim with blank lines. Sun comments contain their full permissive grant. Arm original copyright/SPDX comments are accompanied by the full musl MIT license, not shipped as SPDX-only substitutes.
muslMath.reason: Pinned QuickJS quickjs.c js_math_funcs exports the listed libm functions; its wrapper compiles that source with -lm. Internal helper/data sources follow those functions, not an audit of unused architecture-specific libc ports. OpenJPEG decoder also uses libm.
muslMath.unchangedEvidence: All retained legal comments are byte-identical at the 2021-11-09 and 2026-05-21 immutable source snapshots. Source-path commit histories through 2026-10-15 show only two intervening implementation edits (floor.c and sqrt.c, both fa10d78251ff1b7766988d0b76e1e80b01f4c326), with no legal comment changes; support headers have no intervening changes.

muslQsort.reason: Pinned OpenJPEG src/lib/openjp2/j2k.c opj_j2k_decode_tiles directly calls qsort. Both genuine-source original full MIT notice variants are retained, rather than guessing the cached toolchain source version. Upstream changes the copyright name from Valentin Ochs to Lynn Ochs in the 2026 musl update; no invented copyright or alternate exact-source claim is made.

binaryenFallbackHelpers.copyrightExtraction: Complete initial original copyright/Apache notice comment.
binaryenFallbackHelpers.unchangedEvidence: Both installed fallbacks contain the minified base64 decoding and memory.fill/memory.copy helper templates, in addition to mechanically translated WASM code. Those helper source bodies and the copyright notice are byte-identical at the two immutable endpoints. LICENSE was unchanged from 2015 until the 2024-08-06 append of an FP16-library cross-reference; the full original Apache license bytes remain an unchanged prefix. FP16 is not claimed as embedded.

compilerRuntimeExceptions.reason: Do not automatically attribute the compiler, libc++ headers, or compiler-rt merely because emcc/em++ built the files. The original LLVM object-embedding exception waives Apache sections 4(a), 4(b), and 4(d) for embedded compiled portions. No independent mandatory notice gap for these LLVM portions was established. This exception does not erase the separate Emscripten, musl, Sun, Arm, or Binaryen-template notices.
